Items: orange juice (~200 ml, ~90 kcal), milk in a small bottle (~200 ml, whole, ~120 kcal), a cup of coffee with milk (~40 kcal), cornflakes (~30 g, ~115 kcal), a muffin (~60 g, ~230 kcal), a banana (~100 g peeled, ~90 kcal), and a butter portion (~35 kcal, probably unused).

Served total: 90+120+40+115+230+90+35 = 720 kcal.

Leftover is unknown, so I assume some is left: the butter, part of the muffin, and a little of the other items, about 60 kcal in total. That leaves 660 kcal eaten.

Macros for the eaten food, roughly:
- Juice: 21 g carbs, 1 g protein
- Milk: 7 g protein, 9 g carbs, 6 g fat
- Coffee with milk: 2 g protein, 3 g carbs, 2 g fat
- Cornflakes: 2 g protein, 26 g carbs
- Muffin (about 80% eaten): 3 g protein, 28 g carbs, 9 g fat
- Banana: 1 g protein, 23 g carbs

Totals come to about 16 g protein, 110 g carbs, and 17 g fat.
